```{r merge-metadata}
# meta <- fread("../../../Downloads/sln.metadata.csv")                   # executed just one time 
# df <- unique(meta, by = c("sample"))
# df <- df[, list(orig.ident,SLN_Stage,`Path Accession Number`,SLN_Biopsy, SLN_Biopsy_Date, Sex,Age,SLN_Area, Tumor_Area, `Tumor_Greatest_Dimension(mm)`, Histology, `Primary_Breslow(mm)`, Tumor_Infiltrating_Lymphocytes, `Mitoses(mm^2)`, Ulceration, Recurrence, Recurrence_Date, Months_To_Recurrence, Raw_Recur_Group, Death, Chemotherapy_Treatment, Chemotherapy_Treatment_Type, Immunotherapy_Treatment, Immunotherapy_Treatment_Date,Immunotherapy_Treatment_Type)]
# write.csv(df, "sln.metadata.csv")

md <- pDataDT(sln)
df <- fread("sln.metadata.csv", na.strings = "N/A")
df$list_ID <- c("ctrl.1","ctrl.2","ctrl.3","ctrl.4","ctrl.5","tumor.1", "tumor.2", "tumor.3","tumor.4", "tumor.5", 
                "tumor.6", "tumor.7", "tumor.8", "tumor.9", "tumor.10")
setcolorder(df, colnames(df)[c(27, 2:26) ]);  df$V1 <- NULL   # clean up column names & order of columns 
a <- as.data.frame(table(md$list_ID))        # how many rows are there per sample, but this orders the result before returning
b <- unique(md$list_ID)                      # this will give the correct order of appearance in the table
a <- a[match(b, a$Var1), ]                    # give the table in order
toChange <- names(df)[c(9:11,14:15, 19, 21)]  # have to turn these from char to numeric or later plots will all break
for (i in toChange) {  df[, (i) := as.numeric(get(i))]  }   # change columns to numeric
names(df)[11] <- 'Tum_Gr_Dim'                 # column 11 is a problem, only works if the name is way shorter
new_metadata<- df[rep(1:nrow(df), times = a$Freq), ]  # repeat rows the right number of times
md <- cbind(cell_ID=md$cell_ID, new_metadata )        #[,c(1:10, 12:26)])  # works if you limit the number of columns being added?!  
sln <- addCellMetadata(gobject = sln, new_metadata = md, by_column=T, column_cell_ID = 'cell_ID')

rm(new_metadata); rm(a); rm(b)
```

```{r plot-UMAP-AllCells}
md <- pDataDT(sln) 
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'trnsfr_leiden_harmony',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.75, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.5)


```


```{r plot-UMAP-Downsample}
md <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- subset(md, cell_ID %in% sample(md$cell_ID, 2e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'trnsfr_leiden_harmony',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.75, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.5)

```


```{r cluster-feat-heatmap-AllCells, fig.show="hold"}
markers_scran <- findMarkers_one_vs_all(gobject = sln, method = "scran", expression_values = "normalized",
                                        cluster_column = "trnsfr_leiden_harmony", min_feats = 3)

topgenes_scran <- unique(markers_scran[, head(.SD, 5), by = "cluster"][["feats"]])

plotMetaDataHeatmap(sln, expression_values = "normalized",
                    metadata_cols = "trnsfr_leiden_harmony", selected_feats = topgenes_scran,
                    y_text_size = 8, show_values = "zscores_rescaled")


```


```{r exclude-cluster}

md <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- subset(md, !(trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(21, 23)))$cell_ID  # exclude clusters 21 and 23 because pan-neg
sln <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
 

```


```{r plot-ScreePlot-excl1}
# using channels that Sabrina used for downstream clustering
clusterChannels <- c("CD3E", "CD4", "CD8", "TCF1", "TOX", "CD45RO", "CD19", "CD20","HLA DR", "CD38", "IGD", "CXCR5", 
                     "KI67", "CD45", "PAN CYTO", "CD21"," MAC2 GAL3", "IFNG", "MART1", "GP100", "S100B")
sln <- runPCA(gobject = sln, expression_values = "normalized", scale_unit = TRUE, 
              method = "factominer", feats_to_use = clusterChannels)
signPCA(sln, scale_unit = TRUE, scree_ylim = c(0,40))
```


Calculate clusters by Leiden
```{r calculate-Clusters-excl1}

sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.3, n_iterations = 100, 
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_harmony')  # make the clusters
sln <- labelTransfer(x = sln, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_harmony")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data
```

UMAP projection
```{r UMAP-projection-excl1}
sln <- runUMAPprojection(sln, random_subset = 1e5)  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling
```

```{r save-excl-1}
saveRDS(sln, "sln.harmony.excl-1.RDS")
```

```{r label-L1annotation}

df <- data.frame(trnsfr_leiden_harmony = md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony, L1.annot = "Unknown")
df$cell_ID <- md$cell_ID
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(5,9,15,25,26,28,32,33 )), 'L1.annot'] <- "Tcells"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(6,8,18,19 )), 'L1.annot'] <- "Bcells"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(20,23 )), 'L1.annot'] <- "Tumor"
sln <- addCellMetadata(sln, new_metadata = df, by_column = T, column_cell_ID="cell_ID")  # add in the annotations to the main object

md <- pDataDT(sln)
keepCells <- subset(md, cell_ID %in% sample(md$cell_ID, 2e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$L1.annot)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$L1.annot)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'L1.annot',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.5, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.35)

```



```{r subset-B-and-T-cells}
gc()
md <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- md$cell_ID[which(md$L1.annot == "Tcells")]
Tcells <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepCells )

sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Tcells, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.3, n_iterations = 100, 
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Tcells')  # make the clusters
Tcells <- labelTransfer(x = Tcells, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_Tcells")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data

saveRDS(Tcells, "Tcells.UMAP.RDS")
```
